static_traits.name: Lin Tao
static_traits.family_status: Lives with family in Florida, USA
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received in the past; no similar psychological issues have emerged before
static_traits.language_features: Slightly nervous but highly cooperative; clear thinking and expression; able to identify and articulate negative automatic thoughts; Positive attitude; willing to try reality testing and small-step actions

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling failure and Self-doubt in science class after entering tenth grade; these feelings began with one failed science test, and worsened after multiple poor grades; believing I will keep failing in science, thus questioning choosing science as a Learning direction.
basic_info.core_demands: After realizing negative thoughts and feelings of failure are affecting Learning motivation and confidence at school, decided to seek counseling, hoping to identify and challenge these negative thoughts, and Recover motivation and confidence in Learning.
growth_experiences: The first big science test in tenth grade was failed, causing obvious shock and disappointment, followed by multiple poor grades in science class, gradually reinforcing the belief 'I will keep failing', leading to escalated Self-doubt, starting to distance from classmates, Sleep and diet rhythms disrupted; occasionally performed Good on quizzes, but often ignored.

core_beliefs: I am not suited for studying science / I have no ability in science

special_situations.event: The first big science test in tenth grade was failed
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one big exam fails, it means I do not have science ability and will fail forever after
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles down on studying, tries to ask classmates for help, but under the dominance of negative thinking still tends to magnify failure and wavers in study direction
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will always fail at science

special_situations.event: Every time receiving poor science grades
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If grades are not good, it means I am not good enough, not suited for science, and previous efforts and good quiz performances do not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids socializing, distancing from classmates to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This again proves I am not good enough

special_situations.event: Needing to ask Questions or seek support in class or Learning groups
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I expose my inadequacy in front of others, I will be seen as stupid and looked down on
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding joining study groups or attending teachers' office hours, choosing to bear the pressure alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am stupid

special_situations.event: Reflecting on my choice of science as a Learning direction
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot get high scores, it equals choosing the wrong direction; I should have chosen other subjects from the start
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-reproaches with 'should/must', impulsively considers changing direction to escape feelings of failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should have chosen other subjects from the start

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be supported and recognized, to prove one's ability in science and feel at ease
core_conflict.fear: Fearing appearing stupid in front of others, being judged or Being rejected
defense_goal: Avoiding shame and negative evaluation through distancing and avoiding seeking help, maintaining a surface sense of safety

object_relations.object_representation: Classmates/teachers who judge and look down on me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When encouraged to join a study group or go to the teacher's office hours for help
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others will judge me as 'not smart' like in past experiences; I will be looked down on
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expressing worry in a cautious, roundabout tone, emphasizing 'They will think I am stupid', displacing onto others' possible views, avoiding directly committing to try; if further explored, using vague reasons to delay action.

manifestations: Distancing from classmates due to Self-doubt and fear of being judged
Briefly feeling not so lonely and more confident in Learning groups
Hard to open up to family about academic difficulties and negative thinking

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Excessive worry about appearing foolish in front of others
Overly cautious about seeking help and asking Questions, frequent self-judgment
Measuring oneself by high standards, readily attributing things to 'failure'

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Assuming classmates or teachers will look down on oneself
Before evidence is yet obtained, using others' negative views as the basis for action and avoiding seeking help

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Frequently using 'should' constructions (e.g., 'I should have chosen other subjects')
Treats high scores as the only valid proof of ability, ignoring gradual and partial success

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects and instead does it to themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Knows a supportive environment is beneficial yet chooses to bear the stress alone
Not seeking help outwardly, instead self-pressuring and isolating

exception_events.target_problem: When receiving poor science grades, usually falling into feelings of failure and Self-doubt, and avoiding seeking help from classmates or teachers, leading to decreased Learning motivation
exception_events.unique_outcome: Once joined a Learning group and actively asked Questions, gaining peer support and mutual help; in that situation felt more confident, less Loneliness, better Learning results
exception_events.reason: Different support: the Learning group's mutual-help atmosphere reduced stress; different approach: actively asking Questions and communicating; thus on-the-spot Self-doubt and avoidance lessened, confidence improved

exception_events.target_problem: When facing science learning tasks, usually produces catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking out of worry about failure, and finds it hard to maintain effective engagement
exception_events.unique_outcome: More relaxed in a few small quizzes, understood concepts step by step and obtained fairly good grades
exception_events.reason: Different situation: smaller test scale, lower pressure; different approach: reviewing and answering in a more relaxed state, focusing on specific concepts rather than results

positive_force: Has achieved success in quizzes and conceptual understanding, with some foundation in subject learning ability
Able to identify negative thoughts and willing to try reality testing and behavioral experiments
Having a supportive family and potential peer support (study group)
Willing to make small-step action plans (such as going to the teacher's office hours)
negative_force: Overgeneralization and black-and-white thinking reinforcing failure identity
High sensitivity to others' evaluations and mind-reading-style speculation lead to avoidance of seeking help
Frequently using 'should' constructions for self-reproach, negating gradual progress
Social isolation and disturbed sleep and diet weakening learning and recovery ability

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Self-doubt and avoidance of seeking help after receiving poor science grades (with Social isolation)
antecedent: Getting a poor grade in science class
Facing science study tasks and exam review
Thinking about asking Questions / seeking help in class or Learning groups
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking equating one failure with 'forever failing', and Anticipation of others' negative evaluations triggering shame and Fear
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential shame and judgment, avoiding exposing inadequacy in front of others to maintain short-term psychological security
target_behavior.consequence: Significantly decreased Learning motivation and confidence, overall Academic performance affected; distancing from classmates; Sleep and diet rhythms disrupted
